scripts.title: Moving Average Simple
scripts.description: Simple moving average: the mean of the source price over the last length bars; empty until length bars exist.

scripts.title: Moving Average Exponential
scripts.description: Exponential moving average with alpha 2 / (length + 1), seeded with the first source value.

scripts.title: Volume Weighted Average Price
scripts.description: Volume-weighted average price from a session, week, month or a chosen bar, with up to three standard-deviation bands.

anchor_ms.title: Anchor time
anchor_ms.tooltip: UTC milliseconds of the anchor bar when anchor is time.

scripts.title: Linear Regression Channel
scripts.description: Least-squares trend line with standard-deviation bands and Pearson's R, over the last bars or from an anchor bar.

anchor_ms.title: Anchor time
anchor_ms.tooltip: UTC milliseconds of the first bar; 0 uses length.

end_ms.title: End time
end_ms.tooltip: UTC milliseconds of the last bar; 0 is the latest bar.

scripts.title: Bollinger Bands
scripts.description: Simple moving average of the source price with bands mult population standard deviations above and below it.

scripts.title: Relative Strength Index
scripts.description: Relative strength index from Wilder moving averages of gains and losses; 100 without losses, 0 without gains.

scripts.title: Average True Range
scripts.description: Average true range: Wilder moving average of the true range, seeded with its simple average; the first true range is high minus low.

scripts.title: Volume Delta
scripts.description: Buy minus sell volume of each bar as a percentage of its volume: venue taker volume or classified trades when available, otherwise an estimate from intrabar candle direction.

use_buy_volume.title: Use venue buy volume
use_buy_volume.tooltip: True delta from the bar's taker buy volume when the source publishes it; off always estimates from intrabars.

min_coverage.title: Minimum coverage
min_coverage.tooltip: Share of the bar volume the intrabars must cover.

scripts.title: Pivot Points Standard
scripts.description: Classic floor pivot levels P, R1 to R3 and S1 to S3 from the previous period's high, low and close.

scripts.title: EMA Trend Long
scripts.description: Long when the close crosses above the EMA while the one-hour RSI is above 50 and volume delta is positive; ATR stop, fixed 3R target.

require_flow.title: Require positive volume delta
require_flow.tooltip: Bars without venue taker buy volume never qualify.

scripts.title: RSI Reversion Short
scripts.description: Short when the RSI falls back below 70 within three bars of a close above the upper Bollinger Band; swing-high stop, fixed 2R target.

scripts.title: Pivot Bounce Long
scripts.description: Long on a wick touch of the daily S1 or S2 pivot between 09:30 and 11:30 New York time on weekdays; stop below the level, target the nearest of P and R1.

require_trade_delta.title: Require buy volume data
require_trade_delta.tooltip: Bars without venue or trade-classified buy volume never qualify.

once_per_level.title: Trade each level once per day

scripts.title: Liquidity qualification
scripts.description: Strict turnover, open-interest, spread, slippage and funding gates per asset class; missing or stale data is unavailable, never a match.

reject_high_funding_risk.title: Reject high funding risk
reject_high_funding_risk.tooltip: |8h funding| at or above 0.30 % excludes a perpetual.

scripts.title: Price
scripts.description: Latest traded price, or the mark price when the venue publishes no trade, above, below or between values.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Change %
scripts.description: Rolling 24-hour price change in percent above, below or between values.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Volume
scripts.description: Rolling 24-hour or latest-session volume in base units (shares, coins or contracts) above, below or between values.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Turnover
scripts.description: Rolling 24-hour or latest-session traded value in the quote currency above, below or between values.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Relative volume
scripts.description: Volume of the latest closed bar divided by the mean volume of the length bars before it.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Gap %
scripts.description: Opening gap of the latest closed bar in percent of the previous close, above, below or between values.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: Price vs moving average
scripts.description: Latest price above or below the simple or exponential moving average of the closed bars.

scripts.title: Relative Strength Index
scripts.description: Wilder's RSI of the closed bars above, below or between values, such as below 30 for oversold markets.

value2.title: Second value
value2.tooltip: Upper or lower bound for between.

scripts.title: New high or low
scripts.description: The latest closed bar makes the highest high or lowest low of the last length bars, such as a 52-week high on weekly bars.

scripts.title: Price crossing
scripts.description: The closed price crosses a level: crossing in either direction, crossing up or crossing down.

scripts.title: Price channel
scripts.description: The closed price enters or exits a channel between two levels, or closes inside or outside it.

scripts.title: Moving average cross
scripts.description: A fast simple or exponential moving average of the close crosses a slow one, up (golden cross) or down (death cross).

scripts.title: RSI overbought / oversold
scripts.description: Wilder's RSI of the close crosses above the overbought level or below the oversold level.

scripts.title: Volume spike
scripts.description: A closed bar's volume is above a multiple of the mean volume of the bars before it.

scripts.title: Percent change
scripts.description: The close rises or falls by at least a percentage compared with the close a number of bars earlier.

scripts.title: New high or low breakout
scripts.description: A closed bar's high is above, or its low below, every bar of the preceding length bars.
